scope: Advanced Island Connections: reproducible repeated 2×2 field studies and private generation/offspring inspection

implementation.design: Four conditions cross isolated/connected islands with reciprocal partner effects off/on. Each trial starts with the same actual captured organisms and an initial shared private seed. Rainfall, mutation and selection settings stay fixed.
implementation.work: 8, 12 or 24 futures per condition; up to five real generations per future; original 40-generation limit remains. Trials yield to the event loop. Cancellation and unmount cleanup retain the main expedition and previous completed study.
implementation.biologicalRules: Uses the existing fictional Seedwing/Shellseed engine without changing inheritance, mutation, dispersal, parent selection, reciprocal weights or cohort sizes.
implementation.provenance: Every selectable outcome is calculated by the actual engine. A private timeline, exact trait table and real newborn-parent allele records reconstruct the chosen trial and condition. Identical numerical IDs in different private futures do not identify the same organism.
implementation.persistence: Compact source checkpoint stores original seed, founder setting, recorded round settings, queued settings, RNG state, next ID and a deterministic corruption checksum. Restoration replays the engine and verifies the checksum. The checksum is not an authentication mechanism. Saved study outcomes are recomputed from the validated recipe.
implementation.controls: Guided research questions, native trial/condition/species/metric controls, plot point inspection, progress/cancel, captured-source staleness notice, focusable section navigation and no-WebGL access.
implementation.evidence: Dedicated journal record includes full learner reasoning up to 6000 characters, prediction, captured settings, all individual outcomes, paired contrasts, seeds and limitations. JSON download includes the recipe, plan, raw trajectories, selected response and summaries.

responseDefinitions.within: Census-weighted mean across occupied islands of one neutral biallelic marker H=2p(1-p), from 0 to 0.5; not observed heterozygosity or genome-wide genetic diversity.
responseDefinitions.between: Highest minus lowest A frequency across occupied islands, from 0 to 1; one marker only.
responseDefinitions.trait: Inherited trait mean on the selected island; internal 0–1 values are displayed as 0–100 trait points.
responseDefinitions.divergence: Highest minus lowest inherited trait mean across occupied islands; displayed as 0–100 trait points, not reproductive isolation.
responseDefinitions.summaries: Condition means and observed min/max; each paired contrast excludes only its required missing values. Interaction=(connected-on−isolated-on)−(connected-off−isolated-off). Missing cohorts remain missing, not zero traits.

teachingBoundaries: Replicates are stochastic possible futures conditional on the same captured population, not independently sampled founder populations.
Conditions share an initial private seed within a trial; different dispersal and breeding decisions can change later random draws. These are not matched organisms across futures.
Observed ranges are not confidence intervals, significance tests or empirical uncertainty estimates.
Changing trait lines alone does not establish coevolution. Partner-effects controls expose reciprocal influence within this illustrative model; selection-off paired controls are identical.
Rainfall is held fixed during each study; new studies can capture changed upcoming environmental settings.
The original expedition history and future randomness are unchanged by private studies.
Fictional island genetics does not reconstruct a Galápagos ecosystem, predict a real ecological community, measure genome-wide diversity or establish speciation.

browserJourneys.real3D: One connected, non-lost WebGL context with actual draw calls; no browser page errors.
browserJourneys.mobile: 390px phone, reduced motion, forced WebGL absence, keyboard controls, no page overflow and zero axe WCAG 2 A/AA or 2.1 AA violations in the tested advanced view.
browserJourneys.provenance: Rendered means, paired contrast, actual parent copies and downloaded raw trial data match engine results; main RNG/history remain intact; saved outcomes replay and repeat from captured source.

renderGoldens.infrastructureRecovery: Combined Vitest run passed the main EvoLab render; its second worker timed out before starting the long-tail file. The long-tail EvoLab render passed when rerun alone. No failed assertion was bypassed; only the two EvoLab snapshot entries changed.

validation.visualReview: Inspected desktop/phone field-study screenshots and four regenerated archipelago regression screenshots.

localization.mode: Fallback-aware strings; delta prepared for shared catalog owner. Shared English catalog and translation packs were not modified.
